column1: # Units: see column headers
# Column definitions:
#   test_id = test number as printed in Tables 1-3
#   load_direction = direction of applied load (uplift by vacuum)
#   section_type = purlin cross-section shape (C or Z)
#   depth_in = measured out-to-out depth H of the north/south purlin of the specimen
#   thickness_in = measured base steel thickness t of the north/south purlin
#   span_ft = clear span of the purlins in feet (not printed in feet in the report)
#   n_spans = number of spans of the test specimen (simply supported single span)
#   n_purlin_lines = number of parallel purlin lines in each test specimen
#   panel_type = type of roof panel and attachment to the purlin tension flange
#   bracing = location of the intermediate (discrete) lateral braces
#   failure_load_as_printed = maximum (failure) uniform load Pu as printed in Table 3
#   failure_load_unit = unit of the failure load as printed
#   failure_moment_as_printed = failure moment as printed (not reported)
#   failure_moment_unit = unit of the failure moment
#   failure_mode = observed mode that limited the test
#   value_source = where in the report the failure load is stated
#   pages = PDF page(s) on which the listed values appear
#   span_in_in = purlin span length as printed in Table 1
#   fy_ksi = measured yield stress of north/south purlin
#   lip_angle_deg = measured edge stiffener (lip) angle phi of north/south purlin
#   pu_over_pc = ratio of test failure load to load computed by the Cornell University method
#   pu_over_pc_prime = ratio of test failure load to computed failure load for an unstiffened-flange purlin
#   pu_over_pc_double_prime = ratio of test failure load to load computed by the modified Cornell method
#   mt_over_mn = ratio of test moment (w l^2/8) to nominal moment Se*Fy per 1986 AISI
